title: ICSI Reopens Online Examination Enrolment for December 2026 Session
content:
# ICSI Reopens Online Examination Enrolment for December 2026 Session

Ek important update hai. The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne December 2026 session ke CS Examinations ke liye online examination enrolment window ko dobara open kar diya hai. This is a crucial opportunity for students who might have missed the earlier deadline.

Here are the key details you need to know:

*   **Original Last Date for Enrolment (with late fee):** The earlier deadline to submit the examination enrolment form with a late fee was October 10, 2026.
*   **Reopened Enrolment Window:** The online window for examination enrolment has been reopened from **October 13, 2026, at 11:00 AM to October 19, 2026, till 5:30 PM**.
*   **Services Available:** During this period, students can submit requests for examination enrolment with a late fee, addition of a module with a late fee, and exemption on the basis of higher qualification.
*   **Important Note on Change Services:** Please be aware that during this reopened enrolment window (October 13 to October 19, 2026), the online window for change services (like change of Centre, Medium, Group, and Elective Subject) will remain closed. These services can be availed later, from October 20, 2026, to November 21, 2026, up to 4:00 PM.
*   **Pre-Examination Test & TDOP Deadline:** All students are advised to ensure completion of the Pre-Examination Test (and TDOP for Executive Students, if not already completed) on or before **October 18, 2026, by 5:30 PM**.
*   **Notification Date:** This announcement was made on October 13, 2026.

Students are strongly advised to utilize this extended window and complete all necessary formalities well within the revised deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.
